source_evidence.user_visual_signoff: V20 pyramid bingo and V23 advanced closed shapes good order

canonical_local_frame.warning: Global angle measurements are source-space evidence only. Portable rules must use local-frame offsets.

scale_mapping.density_rule: increase panel count/lattice cells for larger surfaces; do not scale larger for closure unless requested

neighbor_offset_clusters_local.primary_lattice_axes: equilateral triangular face subdivision; target faces must be equilateral or explicitly subdivided into equilateral panels
neighbor_offset_clusters_local.required_next_extraction: cluster actual neighbor_delta_local vectors per source frame

rotation_delta_clusters.source_finding: At is source-phase relative to neighbor/reference direction; raw edge direction alone is insufficient.

failure_modes: raw At=edge direction without C_TRIFLOOR phase correction
using non-equilateral target faces for C_TRIFLOOR triangular tiling
contact-factor-only correction when the target face geometry is wrong
treating C_TRIFLOOR_Q as a scaled C_TRIFLOOR equivalent
centroid-only abstract triangle placement without phase/pivot validation
scaling C_TRIFLOOR down to make an arbitrary mesh without scale/conformance proof
filling a silhouette from independent centers instead of edge/surface/curve-derived transform propagation
claiming a freeform shape is validated because regular closed solids were validated
allowed_variation_slots: uniform scale after separate scale proof
larger geometry via subdivision into equilateral triangular faces
forbidden_substitutions: non-equilateral triangular faces unless a specific distortion/pivot rule is validated

validation.gate: run_gate PASS on V20/V21/V23 lineage; user visual signoff after V23

part_profile.default_orientation_state: builder_default_requires source/control derivation; do not assume generic global angles
part_profile.default_orientation_direction: resolved by Up/At vectors and phase rule
part_profile.bottom_origin_type: not bottom-anchored for face tiling; use centroid/face placement
part_profile.center_origin_type: centroid-based placement validated for C_TRIFLOOR advanced shapes

orientation_phase_rule.rule: corner/primary triangles use Phase A toward neighbor/center; center/inverted triangles use Phase B toward a corner/reference neighbor

scale_behavior.contact_factor_note: do not use global compression as first correction; target faces must match equilateral C_TRIFLOOR geometry

edge_contact_contract.rule: Freeform C_TRIFLOOR structures must be generated from an explicit edge/contact graph, curve-follow contract, or surface mesh with boundary/opening declarations. Centroid-only scatter is not validated.

master_placement_rule.reference_direction: neighbor direction or center-to-corner direction in target face

family_equivalence.required_validation: Do not inherit C_TRIFLOOR rule to Q/F variants until each passes FBX equivalence + default orientation + origin/pivot + scale + phase + proof build.

execution_receipt_requirements.notes: Do not derive triangle placement from visual extents alone; use the validated lattice/phase contract.
additional_required_for_freeform: build-objective conformance check or explicit NOT_RUN status

validated: recursive equilateral subdivision when generated from validated V23-style logic
requires_new_geometry_proof: any use of C_TRIFLOOR as a generic scalable triangle primitive
validated_scope_boundary.hard_rule: Part placement data enables freeform generation only when the generated transforms are derived from an explicit curve/edge/surface graph and checked against the requested objective.
